attBesluta.text: It is an excellent product, from an excellent supplier! Also has the best support center i have ever communicated with! Buy it without any hesitation! Thanks Vevor!

I purchased a piano and was very satisfied after receiving it. However, the bottom panel of the piano was damaged, and the legs were missing from the package. I contacted customer service regarding these issues, and they responded with excellent professionalism and customer care. Initially, we agreed on a partial refund amounting to half of the total payment and generously provided a full refund. I even offered to repay a portion of the amount, but they did not request any further payment. I truly appreciate their high level of customer service and would highly recommend VEVOR to others. Many thanks to VEVOR for their outstanding support and cooperation.

Excelente relación precio/calidad. El proceso de compra fue sencillo y la entrega puntual. Tanto el piano como el banco fueron fáciles de armar y vienen con las herramientas necesarias hacerlo. Me gusta su sonido y la sensación al tocar es similar al de un piano acústico. Además de ser un buen instrumento musical es decorativo y le da un toque de elegancia al salón.

Arrivato... Ho notato qualche altra piccola scheggiatura ma nel complesso direi che sembra abbastanza funzionale ed il suono è nitido

Prévoir le montage d'une manchette ( non fournie ) dimension: 1"1/4 sous la pompe pour le raccordement du tuyau plongeur. Il n'est pas inutile d'ouvrir et démonter le corps de pompe car présence de poussières de limaille d'usinage. J'ai personnellement graissé le piston racleur en cuir avec de la graisse de vaseline spéciale robinetterie et corrigé le jeu des bringuebales avec des entretoises en nylon. La résistance au pompage diminue au fur et à mesure de l'utilisation. Très bonne efficacité de pompage. Peinture de qualité médiocre car apparition de traces de rouille après deux mois. Bon rapport qualité/prix.
Most beautiful pump I've seen.. works perfectly. Craftsmanship is wonderful, bought a smaller one from vever for the kitchen. Will definitely purchase from this company again
I bought it for another property that had a well but no electricity so I could pump water out if I needed to

Buen producto. Buena calidad y acabado. Bien embalado. El único inconveniente es que para si instalación viene con una toma hembra G 1-5/8" (con una rosca de de aprox ∅= 40 mm) y no consigo un racor macho para su montaje adecuado, no sé si debo buscar otra medida equivalente.
Conforme au descriptif. Fonctionnement parfait facile à installer. Installer sur un pied d'une ancienne pompe, obligé de repercé mais sans soucis Je recommande

Save yourself some pain in the ass and replace the nuts with nylon ones and 2mm thicker bolts. The factory ones will loosen in couple of weeks because of play and no nylon in nuts and you will have to tighten them then. Thicker bolts eliminates lots of play and pump becomes much quieter. Also stock bolts and nuts will rust. Use corrosion resistant ones.
Amazing quality and a great price. Thank you for a great transaction.

Très bon chariot, cependant le tissu est fragile: il se décolore avec le temps, une des poignées de transport s'est déchirée, ainsi que la boucle qui sert à replier le chariot. C'est dommage...

Great size for our front door! Has some color with sprigs of off-white colored berries within stems of eucalyptus, but adding additional would give it more “pop”. In general it looks great vs. the Christmas colors which had to be replaced.

Of course I was skeptical about this wreath looking natural enough. I'm really happy with it. The density of the branches and leaves is lush. My front door is six feet from the sidewalk and it looks great even that close up. Our home is small and the size doesn't overwhelm the door. Very pleased with this, especially for the price. It was very easy to arrange the leaves once it was on the door. It's also very light. I'll be keeping this for years.

I read mixed reviews on this wreath so I decided to give my opinion. It needed to be fluffed out but it's absolutely beautiful. It's full and is the perfect size for our front door. Looks pretty realistic too. The price makes it a really good deal. I'd buy it again....

De uitsparing voor de schoudersteun is te klein, waardoor het niet goed in de koffer past. Voor de rest een heel mooie en goede vioolkoffer.

i have chronic pain and chronic illness. this pillow is life changing. as a side sleeper it keeps my back supported, goes between my legs so my hips are aligned, and gives a place for my sore shoulder to go. i came back to buy one for my daughter and am so sad that it is sold out! it took 3 days to fully expand and there was no chemical plastic smell to it.
I bought it as a replacement for an older pillow I had and it has been great. Really soft and supportive

Easy to assemble. It’s sturdy and looks good. Now our outdoor shoes aren’t settling out for people to trip over. Nice item!

Really nice looking and quality-built shoe organizer. It has a fairly large capacity and was really easy to assemble, only took like ten minutes max. You have the ability to put a cushion on top if you would like to for sitting down while putting your shoes on, but you don't need one. It's comfy enough to sit on as it is. Love the functionality of being able to store the shoes on the bottom two shelves and also sit on the bench to put your shoes on. We keep ours by our front door for guests to put on and take off their shoes when they arrive/depart and it looks really nice in our entryway too. Overall, I'd definitely recommend this product. Its built well, provides good value for the price, and looks awesome while still storing quite a few pairs of shoes. Vevor always has good stuff!

Assembling this bench is a straightforward process so anyone can complete it. Designed with premium bamboo material, this shoe bench is built to last. It offers two tiers for shoe storage and the top tier is a comfortable seat to put on your shoes and take them off. It is small by design but functions well where shoe atorage is needed.
The bench is Sturdy and it was easy to assemble. I purchased the smaller one but could’ve went a size up.

Jól néz ki, könnyen összeszerelhető még szerszámkulcsot is adtak hozzá, maradt 1-1 tartalék csavar. Sajnos az ülő felület el volt repedve annak ellenére, hogy a csomagolás ép. Átlagosnál súlyosabb ember ne üljön rá.

This black 3-tier bamboo shoe storage bench offers space for most types of shoes, sneakers, or slippers that are up to size 8.5” but no higher than ankle boots, holds up to six pairs but definitely depends on how big the pair is. The top is flat, somewhat sturdy, says it will hold up to 286 lbs. but I highly doubt it would support you sitting down and putting your shoes on safely. Shelves are nonadjustable, I did yellow circle underneath of the top shelf, it looks like the pieces are put together, also as I was wiping off the top a wood splinter jabbed my finger. It weighs 8.6 lbs. Assembly is required and is fairly easy, no words, just pictures to follow, took me approximately 30 minutes. I strongly suggest looking at the directions and set up what you need ahead of time, no other tools are needed. 27.56"D x 11.42"W x 17.76"H

Excuse the mess but we are remodeling. This light is perfect in the dining room. Plenty of light and beautiful in appearance. Well worth the money.

This light is easily installed, looks beautiful. I have received many compliments on it. I love how its appearance moves as you walk around it. Other reviews had me concerned about it casting shadows and not being adequate light, that has not been my experience. It's perfect and looks more expensive than the great value it is.
